sections.text:
On a warm summer afternoon, the little girl “Alice” was sitting under a big tree in the park with her older sister, who was reading a boring book with no pictures or dialogue.

Alice felt bored and sleepy, and began to imagine a world of her own, full of color and fun.

Suddenly, she saw something very strange passing in front of her: a white rabbit wearing an elegant blue jacket, and carrying a gold pocket watch in his hand!
The rabbit was looking at his watch anxiously and shouted in a human voice: “Oh my God! Oh my God! You are so late!”

Curiosity prompted Alice to leave her sister and run after the white rabbit, who disappeared into a large hole under a tree.

Without thinking about the consequences, Alice jumped into the hole, only to find herself falling into a very deep well that seemed to have no end.

As she fell, she noticed that the walls of the well were full of shelves, books, maps, and mirrors, as if she was falling very slowly to allow her to contemplate everything.

Finally, Alice landed safely on a pile of dry leaves, and found herself in a long hall filled with closed doors on all sides.

I looked for an exit, and found a very small door, and next to it was a glass table with a golden key and a small bottle with the words “Drink me” written on it.

Alice drank from the bottle, and it strangely shrunk until it became the size of a mouse, and was able to enter through the small door!
But she finds herself in an even stranger world, a “Wonderland” where the laws of logic and physics do not apply.

Alice met characters whose existence she had only imagined in dreams. She began with the Cheshire cat with a wide smile, who gradually disappeared, leaving behind nothing but his smile hanging in the air!
The Cat guides her to a crazy tea party being held in the woods, where she meets the Mad Hatter and the Hare, who are celebrating Non-Christmas Day.

Alice sat with them, but the dialogues were illogical, funny, and confusing at the same time, so she decided to leave and continue her exploration.

As she wandered, she found herself in a stunning royal garden, filled with living playing cards that served as soldiers and gardeners!
The soldiers were quickly painting the white roses red, fearing the wrath of the cruel “Red Queen” who ruled this world.

Suddenly, the Red Queen appeared, and she was always an angry person, screaming at everyone who bothered her with her famous phrase: “Cut off his head!”

Queen Alice was forced to play croquet using flamingos as rackets and hedgehogs as balls, and the game was messy and bizarre.

Afterwards, the "Knight" was accused of stealing the Queen's pies, and a farcical trial was held in which the rules were changed by the minute and the verdict was pronounced before the witnesses were heard.

Alice was called as a witness, and at this moment, Alice suddenly began to return to her normal size, and began to grow larger and larger until she became a giant to them.

The Red Queen got angry and ordered the playing cards to attack Alice, so the cards flew in the air and attacked her from all sides.

Alice tried to defend herself and shouted at them: “You're just a pack of weak cards! I'm not afraid of you!”

At that very moment, Alice woke up suddenly, to find herself still under the tree in her garden, and her sister wiping some of the leaves that had fallen on her face.

Alice realized that all those wondrous adventures, the White Rabbit, and the Angry Queen were nothing but a long, deep, beautiful dream.
Alice smiled and told her sister the story of her wonderful dream, keeping in her heart the magical and unforgettable memory of “Wonderland.”
